batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved scan in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-a-2013-2014-set1.pdf (7 pp.). The printed header (p.1) reads: A-ইউনিট, ১ম বর্ষ (সম্মান) ভর্তি পরীক্ষা, ২০১৩-২০১৪, কম্পিউটার সায়েন্স এন্ড ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং বিভাগ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় — boxed 'Set CODE: 1', সময়ঃ ৪৫ মিনিট, পূর্ণমান- ৬০. The Drive listing label 'Set-1' agrees with the printed code, but the paper is a DEPARTMENT paper (Computer Science and Engineering), not a general A-unit set: 60 questions — Bangla Q1-8, English Q9-15, Higher Mathematics Q16-23 and Q25-38, ICT Q24, Physics Q39-60 (subjects assigned per question by content; no subject sections are printed). The compilation prints a boxed key beside each question (উত্তরঃ + Bangla letter for Bangla-medium questions; 'Ans:' + Latin letter for the English questions and inside some Solve boxes) and worked 'Solve:' boxes for most mathematics/physics questions; question text here is stem + options only. 59 of 60 questions keyed; Q57's key letter is cut off by the scan's page edge and is recorded keyless. Two questions (Q22, Q26) carry an internal conflict between the boxed key and the printed Solve — the boxed key is recorded and the conflict documented, per project precedent for these scans. Extraction-stage pack: content and answers unverified pending cross-source verification. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint of the JU A Unit 2013-2014 Computer Science and Engineering department admission paper (printed Set CODE: 1). Aggregator header 'Download More Question Bank From www.admissionwar.com', footer 'Get all University Info From www.admissionwar.com' and diagonal 'Admission War' watermarks are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper; the watermark overlaps a few key boxes and option texts (each such case was zoom-checked and is noted on the question). Downstream cross-check partner (not used here): Satt Academy's JU A 2013-14 Set-3 bank (subcat 7143, stated 60) and the A year bank — identity to be settled at question level.
